description: This Java class 'Combinations' provides utilities to generate combinations of n elements taken k at a time, supporting iteration in lexicographic order, and comparison of generated combinations. It includes inner classes for iteration and comparison logic, and references external utility classes for array and combinatorial calculations.

classes.name: Combinations
classes.description: Main class for generating and iterating over all k-element combinations from an n-element set with lexicographic order, providing iterators and comparators for combination enumeration and comparison.

classes.name: Combinations.IterationOrder
classes.description: Enum defining the iteration order type, currently supporting lexicographic order.

classes.name: Combinations.LexicographicIterator
classes.description: Iterator for producing combinations in lexicographic order following Algorithm T by Knuth.

classes.name: Combinations.SingletonIterator
classes.description: Single-element iterator for handling special cases (full set or empty set).

classes.name: Combinations.LexicographicComparator
classes.description: Comparator providing lexicographic ordering for combination arrays, verifying their validity and comparing based on their lexicographic norm.

methods.name: Combinations.getN
methods.description: Returns the size of the original set from which combinations are generated.

methods.name: Combinations.getK
methods.description: Returns the size of each combination subset.

methods.name: Combinations.iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the combinations in lexicographic order.

methods.name: Combinations.comparator
methods.description: Returns a comparator for comparing combinations lexicographically.
